question: In round 2, after merging the tone mapping into the trace kernel, you ran a 4 spp smoke test writing out/merged.ppm. What setup_ms did that run print?
answer: setup_ms=180.8. That number comes from my own archived tool output for message #245, the run that rebuilt the binary and then executed `./pathtracer --scene-config ../scene-default.json --seed 1 --threads 8 --spp 4 --out ../out/merged.ppm --out-pfm ../out/merged.pfm` (the spp-4 smoke test right after tone mapping was merged into trace_kernel). Its full status line was: `setup_ms=180.8 samples=1048576 width=512 height=512 spp=4 threads_used=8 triangles=69451 bvh_nodes=40597`, with PROG_EXIT=0 and merged.pfm 3145744 bytes / merged.ppm 786447 bytes. Note bvh_nodes=40597 there, i.e. that was still the kLeafSize=4 tree; the current live build (kLeafSize=1) prints bvh_nodes=131071 with setup_ms around 148-182.
